from pathlib import Path
import textwrap
program_dir=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-high-fresh0/frozen/seen-reference-2/play/users/u082/system/state/workspace/programs')
program_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source='''from collections import Counter


def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    flat = [value for row in grid for value in row]
    background = Counter(flat).most_common(1)[0][0]

    row_modes = [Counter(row).most_common(1)[0][0] for row in grid]
    col_modes = [Counter(grid[r][c] for r in range(h)).most_common(1)[0][0] for c in range(w)]
    common_modes = set(row_modes) & set(col_modes)
    line_color = max((v for v in common_modes if v != background),
                     key=lambda v: row_modes.count(v) + col_modes.count(v))

    separator_rows = [r for r, v in enumerate(row_modes) if v == line_color]
    separator_cols = [c for c, v in enumerate(col_modes) if v == line_color]
    active_cols = [c for c in separator_cols
                   if any(grid[r][c] != line_color for r in separator_rows)]
    crossings = [[grid[r][c] for c in active_cols] for r in separator_rows]

    output = []
    for r in range(len(crossings) - 1):
        out_row = []
        for c in range(len(active_cols) - 1):
            values = {crossings[r][c], crossings[r][c + 1],
                      crossings[r + 1][c], crossings[r + 1][c + 1]}
            if len(values) == 1 and line_color not in values:
                out_row.append(next(iter(values)))
            else:
                out_row.append(background)
        output.append(out_row)
    return output
'''
